info.title: Commerce API
info.description: Our Commerce API powers digital ordering via endpoints that provide store details, menu data, basket calculation and validation and provides a checkout flow to handle POS order injection.

oauth2ClientCredentials.description: Obtain an access token using the partner client ID and client secret. Send the returned token with each API request in the Authorization header as a Bearer token.

value.description: Description

channel.description: Global identifier of the ordering channel/platform.

id.description: Unique identifier of the basket item, auto-generated when the item is added. Used to reference the item in subsequent requests (e.g. `itemIds` in discounts).

menuId.description: Internal Deliverect menu id. You can retrieve the `menuId` via [GET Store Menu](https://developers.deliverect.com/v3.0-ordering-experience/reference/commerce-get-menus).

plu.description: Unique identifier of the item, to be used when creating orders.

quantity.description: Number of units of the item added to the basket.

price.description: Unit price of the item. Expressed as an integer in the smallest currency unit, e.g. 1000 = 10.00.

gross.description: Item total before tax, including modifiers and quantity. Expressed as an integer in the smallest currency unit, e.g. 1000 = 10.00.

rate.description: Tax rate with 3 decimal digits, e.g. 10.5% = `10500`.

amount.description: Tax amount applied. Expressed as an integer in the smallest currency unit, e.g. 1000 = 10.00.

net.description: Item total including tax. Expressed as an integer in the smallest currency unit, e.g. 1000 = 10.00.

price.description: Unit price of the modifier. Expressed as an integer in the smallest currency unit, e.g. 1000 = 10.00.

Tip amount. Expressed as an integer in the smallest currency unit, e.g. 1000 = 10.00.

type.description:
Recipient of the tip:

- `restaurant` - Tip for the restaurant
- `driver` - Tip for the delivery driver

donationTotal.description: Total of all donations. Expressed as an integer in the smallest currency unit, e.g. 1000 = 10.00.

discountsTotal.description: Total of all discounts. Expressed as an integer in the smallest currency unit, e.g. 1000 = 10.00.

chargesTotal.description: Total of all charges (service charge, bag fee, delivery fee). Expressed as an integer in the smallest currency unit, e.g. 1000 = 10.00.

taxTotal.description: Total tax. Expressed as an integer in the smallest currency unit, e.g. 1000 = 10.00.

tipTotal.description: Total of all tips. Expressed as an integer in the smallest currency unit, e.g. 1000 = 10.00.

subTotal.description: Sum of item totals before tax, discounts, charges and tips. Expressed as an integer in the smallest currency unit, e.g. 1000 = 10.00.

total.description: Final amount payable. Expressed as an integer in the smallest currency unit, e.g. 1000 = 10.00.

payment.description: Calculated payment totals for the basket.

companyName.description: Name of the company or organization associated with the order.

phoneNumber.description:
Customer's contact number for order confirmation or delivery communication.

Eg., "+3211223344"

externalId.description: External reference ID for the customer in a third-party system.

loyaltyProviderCustomerId.description: Unique identifier for the customer in the loyalty provider system.

tin.description: Tax identification or fiscal equivalent number for the customer.

crmProfileId.description: Unique identifier for the customer's profile in the Deliverect CRM system.

sendNotifications.description: Flag to control whether order notifications should be sent to the customer.

allowMarketing.description: Flag to indicate whether the customer has opted in to receive marketing communications.

sendReceiptSMS.description: Flag to control whether the order receipt should be sent via SMS.

sendReceiptEmail.description: Flag to control whether the order receipt should be sent via email.

customer.description: Information about the customer placing the order.

group.description: Group order details. `null` for non-group baskets.

customers.description: Customers participating in the group basket.

id.description: Internal customer ID, auto-generated when the customer is added to the basket.

role.description:
Role in the group:

- `host` - Customer who owns the group basket
- `guest` - Customer who joined the group basket

policies.description: Deadlines applied to the group basket.

type.description:
Policy type:

- `newJoinersDeadline` - Last time new customers can join
- `groupItemsModificationDeadline` - Last time any items can be changed
- `customerItemsModificationDeadline` - Last time a specific customer can change their items

customerId.description: Customer the policy applies to (only for `customerItemsModificationDeadline`).

type.description:
Types of orders to be included inside the `fulfillment` object. These are the allowed values:

- `pickup` - Takeaway orders
- `delivery` - Delivery handled directly by the ordering platform
- `eatIn` - Orders consumed on premises (dine-in)

time.description:
Timestamp in UTC, `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`. All time values in our API are in UTC time as per [ISO8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601).

*(For delivery, pickup, and any non-ASAP order.)*

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Number of stores to be returned per page - Max: 100

parameters.name: latitude
parameters.description: Reference latitude coordinate to calculate store distance. Querying by `latitude` & `longitude` returns stores with a `distance` attribute representing, in metres, how far the store is from the given coordinates. To sort results by distance, add `&sort=distance`.

parameters.name: longitude
parameters.description: Reference longitude coordinate to calculate store distance. Querying by `latitude` & `longitude` returns stores with a `distance` attribute representing, in metres, how far the store is from the given coordinates. To sort results by distance, add `&sort=distance`.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Attribute to sort results by (requires `latitude` & `longitude` to be supplied).

parameters.name: fulfillmentType
parameters.description: Refines the stores returned to those supporting the specified fulfillment type(s). Combine multiple types (comma-separated) to match stores supporting any of the specified types.

total.description: Total number of stores returned by the query

page.description: Current page number of the paginated response

size.description: Number of store records returned per page

items.description: List of store objects. Each object contains details about one store location.

id.description: Unique identifier of the Deliverect store, referred to as `channelLinkId` in basket and checkout processing

channelLinkId.description: Identifier linking the store to a sales channel (same value as `id`)

channelLocationId.description: A location identifier known to the channel platform (set within channel settings)

channel.description: Global identifier of the ordering channel/platform

name.description: Assigned name for the specific store in Deliverect (not necessarily a customer facing store name)

currency.description: Default currency used at this store for transactions. See list of currencies here.

address.description: Store's address details, including source, coordinates, and location info (country, city, state)

source.description: Full address as a single string
source.example: 1 Main street D13 R2P6 Ghent VOV

coordinates.description: Longitude and Latitude of the store. Example: [25.276987, 55.296249]

country.description: Country where the store is located

stateOrProvince.description: State or province of the store

openingHours.description: Store's standard operating hours by day of week, including timezone. See more info on store opening hours here.

dayOfWeek.description: Day of the week (`1` = Monday, `7` = Sunday)

specialHours.description: Exceptions to regular hours (holidays, special events)

start.description: First date of the special-hours period (`YYYY-MM-DD`)

end.description: Last date of the special-hours period (`YYYY-MM-DD`)

days.description: Per-date detail within the special period

date.description: The specific date the exception applies to

holiday.description: Whether the store is fully closed (holiday) on this date

openingHours.description: Time ranges the store is open on this date

begin.description: Local opening time on the special date

end.description: Local closing time on the special date
